newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Purchasing Mgrs Sept index falls to 56.3.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Purchasing Mgrs Sept index falls to 56.3.

text.p: The Chicagoland Business Barometer fell to a seasonally adjusted 56.3 in September from 60.0 in August, the Purchasing Management Association of Chicago (PMAC) said on Monday.
An index below 50 signals a slowing manufacturing economy, while a reading above 50 suggests expansion.
The prices paid index rose to 59.3 in September from 51.8 in August.
The employment component of the barometer rose to 50.8 in September from 49.7 in August.

The Purchasing Management Association of Chicago said the business barometer "maintains momentum" despite September's drop.
The group also said "production, new orders and order backlog ease, while prices paid jumps (and) supplier deliveries record the 18th month without breaking 50."
They said the production index fell back four points but remained strong, and new orders held almost all of August's surge.
